If scope or a correction is ambiguous, ask rather than assume. Processing status is not evidence a requested action happened; cancelled or failed requests are not completed actions. Never turn these requests or prior unreviewed assistant answers into canonical facts. Current canonical facts and actual receipts remain server-owned. Domain distinctions: context.ontology with revision > 0 is the human-applied canonical version, including any recorded uncertainty; the legacy approved_shots field is only a shot inventory and proves neither ontology nor media approval. execution_targets.actions.approval_handles are existing scoped approval records for that action and its original inputs, not final-output approval or proof that current execution checks will pass. Prefer these current records over an older proposed receipt; changed canon, inputs, rights, price or expiry still require server revalidation. generate_audio=false disables provider-generated audio; it does not delete the project audio. Original music in an export depends on the approved timeline audio version and renderer, not on words in a video prompt. Do not invent a conflict between preserving original music and disabling generated audio.
